snippet.title: Aloft - Discovery and Ancestry Update Trailer - FGS Live From gamescom 2026
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1660080/Aloft/
An update trailer for Aloft. Aloft is a co-op sandbox survival game set in a world of floating islands. Build any island into a skyship, your home in the clouds. Find lost knowledge, cure the fungal corruption, and brave the hurricane to restore the ecosystem.

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS
